verses.text: Blessed is the one who dodges bad vibes, haters, and toxic crowds; they don’t roll with sinners or join the gossip squad.
Instead, they vibe fully with God’s word, meditating on it day and night.
They’re like a tree planted by streams of water—always nourished, always thriving, never dry.
Whatever they do? It pops off—they succeed in all their moves.
The wicked? Nah, they’re like chaff the wind blows away—no roots, no staying power.
God watches the path of the righteous, but the wicked? Their way crashes and burns.
Why are the nations wildin’ and plotting nonsense like they can outplay God?
Earth’s leaders link up, forming “Anti-God Alliance,” trying to go against the Lord and His chosen King.
They say, “Let’s break free from God’s rules; we don’t want His control.”
Meanwhile, God in heaven is literally laughing—He’s unbothered.
Then He speaks, and His words shake them—He shuts them down real quick.
“I already crowned My King on Zion, My holy hill.”
The King says, “Let me tell you what God said: ‘You are My Son; today I declare You Mine.’”
“Ask Me, and I’ll hand you the nations; the whole world is yours.”
“You’ll break rebellious nations like pottery smashed with an iron rod.”
So, kings—be smart. Leaders—take this seriously.
Serve the Lord with reverence; tremble but obey Him.
Honor the Son, or chaos will catch you slipping; His anger fires up fast. Blessed are the ones who take refuge in Him.
Lord, my ops are multiplying—whole crowd rising up against me.
They’re out here saying, “God ain’t saving him fr.”
But You, Lord, are my shield—my glow-up, the One who lifts my head back up.
I cried out to You, and You answered me straight from Your holy mountain.
I lay down, slept, and woke up again—’cause You kept me alive.
I won’t stress even if ten thousand mobs pull up against me.
Rise up, Lord! Save me! You’re the One who claps my enemies and breaks their power.
Salvation belongs to You, Lord—let Your blessing rest on Your people.
God of my righteousness, pick up my call—You’ve pulled me out of tight spaces before, so show me mercy again and hear me out.
Yo people, how long you gonna drag my name and chase lies like it’s a hobby?
Just know this: the Lord sets apart His people for Himself—when I call Him, He actually answers.
Chill out and stop wilding—think deeply on your actions when you’re quiet on your bed.
Offer the right sacrifices and put real trust in the Lord.
Everybody’s asking, “Who gonna bless us? Who gonna give us light?” Lord, shine Your face on us.
You’ve put more joy in my heart than people get when their bag is overflowing.
I can lie down and sleep in full peace—’cause You alone, Lord, lock in my safety.
Lord, hear me out — catch my words and peep my heart’s whispers.
My King and my God, You’re the One I pray to, so yeah, I’m calling on You.
Every morning I pull up with my prayers; I lay everything out and wait on You like refresh-loading.
You’re not a God who vibes with wickedness — evil can’t sit near You.
Arrogant people won’t survive in Your presence; You hate every move evil folks make.
You destroy liars; violent and deceitful people? The Lord detests them.
But me? I step into Your house by Your mercy — I bow down in awe toward Your holy temple.
Lord, lead me in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make Your path straight ahead of me.
Their words can’t be trusted — their insides are a whole disaster; their throats are like open graves, and their tongues just smooth-talk lies.
Rain judgment on them, O God — let their own schemes trap them. Kick them out for their many sins, ’cause they rebel against You.
But let everyone who trusts in You be hype and joyful — let them shout for joy forever, ‘cause You protect them.
For You, Lord, bless the righteous and cover them with favor like armor.
LORD, don’t stay angry; don’t punish me too hard.
Heal me, LORD; I’m weak, my bones ache.
My soul is in distress; how long will this last?
Turn, LORD, save me; show your mercy.
In death, no one remembers you; the grave can’t give thanks.
I’m full of tears; I weep all night.
My eyes are drained from constant crying.
Depart from me, all who do evil; the LORD heard my cries.
The LORD has heard my prayer; He accepts it.
Let all my enemies be ashamed and turned back.
LORD my God, I run to you; save me from my haters.
Save me or I’ll get shredded; don’t let my soul get wrecked.
LORD my God, if I did wrong, if there’s guilt in my hands—
If I returned evil for evil, or crushed my foes instead of mercy—
Let my enemy chase me, but never get the win; let justice hit them.
The LORD judges right; He’s furious with the wicked every day.
If they won’t repent, He sharpens His sword; readies His bow, armed and ready.
He’s ready; He’s plotting doom for the nations who stand against Him.
The LORD’s wrath reaches the wicked, He’s the ultimate defender.
My shield is God, who saves the pure of heart.
God is righteous; He loves right living; the upright can trust Him.
God’s eye sees everyone; the wicked can’t hide.
If they turn evil, He readies His sword; His bow is strung, arrows fly.
The wicked dig their own pit; they fall into the trap they made.
God’s wrath is real; it burns those who plot injustice.
The LORD is my shield; He saves the good, judges the wrong.
I’ll give thanks to the LORD for His righteousness; I’ll sing for the name of the LORD Most High.
LORD, your name is huge, way above earth and sky, your glory shows everywhere.
Babies and kids shut up your enemies, God, that’s wild.
When I look at the sky, your fingers made the moon and stars.
Humans? You even notice us? Crazy that you care.
You made us just below angels, crowned us with honor.
You gave us rule over your works, everything under our feet.
All the animals—sheep, oxen, and wild beasts.
Birds in the sky, fish in the sea, everything swimming its lane.
LORD, your name is massive, your glory is above all.
Lord, I’m giving you full praise — whole heart in. I’m talking about everything you’ve done.
I’m rejoicing in you; your name stays honored on my lips.
My enemies pull up, but they trip and fall because you back me.
You sit on the throne and judge right — my case is safe with you.
You call out the nations doing evil; you shut down the wicked and erase their name for good.
Their cities? Gone. Their plans? Finished. Memory deleted.
But you, Lord, stay forever; your throne stands solid in justice.
You judge the whole world with truth and rule the nations with fairness.
You’re a refuge for the oppressed — a safe spot in hard times.
Anyone who knows your name trusts you, because you never ignore the ones who seek you.
Sing to the Lord who rules from Zion; let the world know what He’s done.
He remembers the cries of the harmed; He doesn’t forget them.
Lord, be gracious to me. Look at the trouble I’m in from those who hate me — lift me from death’s edge.
I’ll praise you openly and rejoice in your rescue.
The nations fall into the traps they made; their own plans catch them.
The Lord shows Himself through righteous judgment; the wicked get caught in their own works.
The wicked head toward the grave — the same for nations that forget God.
But the needy aren’t forgotten; their hope won’t die out.
Rise up, Lord. Don’t let humans act like they run the world; let the nations face your justice.
Put them in place, Lord, so they finally learn they’re just human.
Lord, why do you feel far? Why hide when things get rough?
The wicked flex on the weak; let their own schemes hit them back.
The wicked brag on their desires and disrespect you.
Pride blinds them — they don’t seek you, and you’re not in their thoughts.
Their ways look smooth for now; your judgments seem far to them. They look down on others.
They think, “I’ll never fall; nothing bad will touch me.”
Their mouth stays full of cursing, lies, and trouble.
They hide waiting to ambush the helpless; they target the vulnerable.
They lurk like a lion in hiding, ready to drag the poor into their traps.
The helpless get crushed and fall under their pressure.
They think, “God forgot; He won’t notice.”
Rise up, Lord; lift your hand. Don’t forget the afflicted.
Why does the wicked think you won’t call them out?
But you *do* see it — the trouble, the grief — and you handle it. The weak trust you; you defend the fatherless.
Break the power of the wicked; expose every evil they’ve done.
The Lord is King forever; evil nations vanish from His land.
You hear the cries of the humble; you give them strength and listen closely.
You defend the fatherless and the oppressed, so people of the earth won’t keep terrifying others.
I take refuge in the Lord. So why you telling me, “Run to the mountains like a scared bird”?
Look — the wicked got their bow pulled back, aiming in the dark at people with clean hearts.
If the foundations break down, what can the righteous even do?
The Lord is in His holy temple; His throne is in heaven. He sees everything; His eyes test everyone.
The Lord checks the righteous, but He hates those who love violence.
He’ll rain fire and scorching wind on the wicked — that’s their portion.
Because the Lord is righteous; He loves righteousness. The upright will see His face.
Help, LORD — the faithful are disappearing; loyal ones are hard to find.
Everybody talks fake, smooth words, double-minded energy.
LORD, cut off the lying lips and the braggy tongues.
Those who say, “Our words run things; nobody can check us.”
“Because the poor are pressed and the needy cry out, I will rise,” says the LORD. “I’ll protect them.”
The LORD’s words are pure — like silver refined seven times.
You, LORD, will guard them; You’ll keep them safe forever.
The wicked roam everywhere when evil is praised.
LORD, how long will You forget me? How long will You hide Your face?
How long will I wrestle with myself and feel sorrow all day? How long will my enemy stay ahead?
Look at me, LORD my God; answer me. Give light to my eyes or I’ll fall.
My enemy will say, “I beat him,” and my foes will celebrate when I slip.
But I trust Your mercy; my heart rejoices in Your salvation.
I’ll praise You, LORD, because You’ve been good to me.
The fool says in his heart, “There’s no God.” People acting corrupted; nobody’s doing right.
The LORD looked down to see if anyone seeks Him.
All turned aside; all messed up. No one does good — not even one.
Do the evil ones not get it? They consume My people like bread and don’t call on the LORD.
They’ll shake with fear, because God stands with the righteous crew.
You shame the poor, but the LORD is their refuge.
Oh that salvation for Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His people, let Jacob rejoice; let Israel be glad.
The fool says in his heart, “There’s no God.” People acting corrupted; nobody’s doing right.
The LORD looked down to see if anyone seeks Him.
All turned aside; all messed up. No one does good — not even one.
Do the evil ones not get it? They consume My people like bread and don’t call on the LORD.
They’ll shake with fear, because God stands with the righteous crew.
You shame the poor, but the LORD is their refuge.
Oh that salvation for Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His people, let Jacob rejoice; let Israel be glad.
LORD, who may stay in your tabernacle? Who may dwell on your holy hill?
The one who walks right, does what’s true, and speaks truth from the heart.
Doesn’t slander, doesn’t harm others, doesn’t insult their neighbor.
Honors those who fear you; rejects what’s evil; keeps their word even when it hurts.
Doesn’t cheat people, doesn’t take bribes. This one stands firm and won’t be moved.
Keep me safe, O God; I run to you for refuge.
I said to the LORD, “You’re my Lord; every good thing I have comes from you.”
The people who follow you are the ones I delight in.
Those who chase other gods only multiply pain; I won’t join them or call on their names.
LORD, you’re my portion and my cup; you hold my future steady.
You placed me in good territory; the inheritance you gave me is solid.
I bless you for guiding me; even at night, you correct my thoughts.
I keep you before me always; because you’re at my right hand, I won’t be shaken.
My heart is glad, my soul rests, my body lives secure.
You won’t abandon me to the grave; you won’t let your holy one see decay.
You show me the path of life; in your presence is fullness of joy, and at your right hand are eternal pleasures.
Lord, hear me — my request is honest. My lips aren’t playing fake.
Let my verdict come straight from You; You see everything clearly.
You checked my heart, You watched me at night, You tested me — I’m not out here plotting wrong.
I’ve kept away from shady paths; Your words kept me steady.
Keep my steps firm on Your road so I don’t slip.
I call on You ’cause You always answer — listen to me, Lord.
Show me Your amazing love, the kind that saves those who trust in You.
Keep me as Your “eye-apple” — hide me under Your wings.
Protect me from the enemies hunting me down.
They’re heartless; their mouths talk big.
They surround me, watching every move.
They’re like a lion ready to pounce.
Rise up, Lord — stop them. Bring them down by Your hand.
Save me from people who live for this world only.
But me? I’ll see Your face in righteousness; when I wake, I’ll be satisfied with being like You.
God’s my rock, my shield, my ultimate backup.
My fortress, my safe spot, my stronghold.
I shout to Him, He always listens.
Trouble surrounds me, waves of chaos everywhere.
I call for help, He pulls through instantly.
Darkness tried to trap me, He lights the way.
The earth shook, mountains trembled—His power showed.
Skies flashed, storms shook, His presence is real.
The ground moved, hills wobbled, God’s wrath was clear.
He came fast, untouchable, swooping through.
Enemies attacked, arrows flew, He shielded me.
He trained my hands, gave me strength to fight.
Enemy defenses broke, I stood unshaken.
He leveled me up, gave me skill and courage.
I moved safely, path clear, fear gone.
My foes stumbled, couldn’t touch me.
They tried, they fell, justice served.
God kept me safe, my peace secure.
He punished the wicked, exposed their plans.
They were humbled, saw His hand.
My crown secure, His faithfulness unmatched.
He rewards the ones who walk true.
He guides my steps, keeps me aligned.
Strength from Him, I stand firm.
My path straight, no detours, no lies.
God matches my energy—pure and real.
He shields me, keeps me on track.
I shout, He backs me, full confidence.
Storms obey His name.
Ground steady, I move strong.
He’s my ultimate support, never fails.
Ready for battle, powered by Him.
He equips me with wisdom, skill, focus.
Barriers break, doors open by His hand.
Light guides me, no darkness blocks.
Enemies exposed, powerless.
Their plans collapse, they stumble.
I move sure, His strength in me.
Respect comes, His name honored.
I dodge traps, nothing sticks.
Life’s chaos? Handled, confidence solid.
He levels me up, keeps me strong.
Focused, precise, moving with skill.
Obstacles cleared, path ready.
My steps swift, foes fall behind.
Sure-footed, stable, grounded in Him.
God’s my MVP, always reliable.
Victory is His, I give Him praise.
His power eternal, mercy never ends.
Forever grateful, His love sustains me.
Look up—the sky’s showing off God’s epic power, clear for everyone to see.
Every day speaks His story, every night whispers His wisdom.
No words needed—the universe itself tells the truth.
His message travels everywhere, reaching everyone without fail.
The sun comes out like a champion on a mission, spreading warmth and energy.
It doesn’t miss a beat, lighting up the earth from corner to corner.
God’s law is perfect—guiding souls, giving life, leveling us up in the right way.
His rules are trustworthy, clear, and just—they make simple hearts wise.
Respecting God? Eternal power, lasting forever.
His commands are priceless, sweeter than honey, more valuable than gold.
Following them keeps you safe and wise; ignoring them is a trap.
Help me notice my mistakes, even the ones I can’t see.
Keep me from messing up badly—protect me from sin’s traps.
Let my words and thoughts honor You, God—my strength and my guide.
May the Lord notice you instantly in your bad days and may the God of Jacob pull up for you when life swings.
May He send you backup from His throne and may His strength hold you steady from Zion.
May He remember every sacrifice you’ve made and may He honor every offering you’ve placed before Him.
May He give you the exact desires He Himself shaped in your heart and help all your plans line up with His will.
We will celebrate when He comes through and lift His name like a banner after the victory. May the Lord fulfill every request that lines up with Him.
Now I know this for real: The Lord rescues His chosen one. He answers from heaven with power only He owns.
Some people trust systems and strength, but we trust the name of the Lord our God.
They trip and collapse, but we stay standing because He keeps us standing.
Lord, save us. And let the king You’ve placed hear us when we cry out.
Lord, the king celebrates Your strength, and he’s hyped because You give real victories.
You didn’t ignore what he wanted — You actually handed him the desires he prayed for.
You blessed him with goodness straight from You and placed a crown on his head — one that actually means something.
He asked for life, and You gave him long years that stretch beyond what he imagined.
Your victories made him shine, and You dressed him with honor and glory that only You can give.
You put him in blessings that don’t expire, and Your presence makes him overflow with joy.
Because the king trusts You, Your unfailing love keeps him steady and unshaken.
Your hand finds every enemy, Your right hand catches anyone standing against You.
You burn through opposition like fire, and Your presence wipes out wicked plans.
You remove their influence from earth, and their legacy fades — they won’t get to continue their damage.
They try to plan evil against You, but their schemes can’t survive Your power.
You make them turn back in fear because Your arrows hit what they aim at.
Lord, rise up in Your strength; we’ll praise You for the power You keep showing.
God… why do You feel far? I’m crying out but it’s like You’re silent.
Day and night I call, but it feels like no answer is landing.
But You’re still holy, and Your people praise You nonstop.
Our ancestors trusted You, and You came through for them.
They cried to You and got saved; they trusted, and You didn’t embarrass them.
But right now I feel small — like people see me as nothing.
Everyone watching mocks me, shaking their heads like they already know my story.
“Let his God save him,” they say — “since he claims God likes him.”
But You’re the One who brought me out safely from birth; You’ve been with me since day one.
From my first breath, You’ve been my God — I’ve always been dependent on You.
So don’t stay far — trouble is close and there’s no human help.
People surround me like strong bulls, trying to pressure me.
They open their mouths at me like lions ready to strike.
I feel like I’m melting inside; my strength is leaking away.
My energy is dried out, and my tongue sticks like I'm dehydrated. You’ve let me hit the ground.
Enemies surround me like wild dogs; they pierce my hands and feet.
I can see all my bones; people stare at me with zero mercy.
They divide my clothes and cast lots for what I’m wearing.
But Lord, don’t stay distant — You’re my strength, hurry to help me.
Save my life from the sword; save me from the danger right in front of me.
Rescue me from the lions’ mouths and the horns of wild animals.
I’ll tell my brothers about You; I’ll praise You in the assembly.
All who respect God — praise Him. Everyone connected to Jacob — honor Him.
God didn’t ignore the suffering one. He didn’t hide. He heard the cry.
My praise comes from You, and I’ll keep honoring You publicly.
The humble will eat and be filled; those who seek the Lord will live in joy.
The whole world will remember God and come back to worship Him.
Because the kingdom belongs to the Lord — He’s the One ruling every nation.
All people — strong and weak — will bow before Him.
Future generations will serve Him; they’ll hear about what He’s done.
They’ll pass down the story: “God did this. He finished it.”
The Lord is my Shepherd — I’m fully covered. I’m not lacking anything.
He settles me in calm places and leads me where my soul can breathe again.
He restores my whole vibe and guides me into the right path ’cause His name stays pure.
Even when I walk straight into dark seasons, I’m not shaking — ’cause You’re right there with me. Your protection keeps me stable.
You set a whole table for me right in front of the people betting on my downfall. You refresh me, and Your blessings stay overflowing.
Your goodness and mercy are basically stalking me for life — and I’m staying in Your house forever.
The earth and everything in it? Yeah, that’s all God’s — He runs the whole system.
He built it from the ground up, set it steady on the waters.
Who can step into God’s space? Who can stand where He is?
Only the one with clean hands and a clean heart — no idols, no fake vibes, no deceit.
That person gets blessing from the Lord and approval from the God who saves.
That’s the squad of people who seek Him — the ones who chase after His presence.
Lift up your heads, gates; open wide, ancient doors — the King of Glory is stepping in.
And who’s this King of Glory? The Lord — strong and unstoppable in battle.
Lift your heads again, gates; open up, ancient doors — the King of Glory is entering.
Who is this King of Glory? The Lord of hosts — yeah, that’s Him.
Lord, I lift my whole life to You — You’re the One I’m banking on.
I trust You fully; don’t let me get clowned or end up ashamed.
Anyone who waits on You won’t be disappointed — only the ones wilding out in rebellion get exposed.
Show me Your paths, Lord; teach me how You move.
Guide me in Your truth — You’re my God and my Savior; I’m waiting on You all day.
Remember Your mercy and love — they’ve been Your style since forever.
Don’t pull up my past mistakes or teen-level foolishness — look at me through Your mercy, ’cause You’re good.
God is solid and upright — that’s why He teaches sinners the right path.
He guides the humble step-by-step and shows them His way.
Every path He leads is full of love and truth for the ones keeping His covenant.
For Your name’s sake, forgive my mess — yeah, it’s a lot.
Whoever reveres the Lord? He gets shown the best route for his life.
He’ll live in goodness, and his children will inherit the land.
The Lord shares His secrets with those who fear Him — He lets them in on His covenant.
My eyes stay locked on Him ’cause He’s the One who pulls me out of traps.
Turn to me, Lord — I’m feeling lonely and stressed.
My problems are stacking — pull me out before they bury me.
Look at my pain and struggles and wipe out all my sins.
See how many enemies I’ve got and how they hate me for no reason.
Guard me and save me — I’m trusting You, don’t let me be ashamed.
Let integrity and uprightness protect me because my hope is in You.
Redeem Israel, God — step in for Your people.
Lord, check my case — I’ve walked straight. I’ve been trusting You without switching sides.
Run the diagnostics on my heart and mind — test me for real.
Your love stays in front of me, and I move according to Your truth.
I don’t link up with fakes, and I’m not vibing with shady people.
I literally can’t stand gatherings of wickedness — I’m not sitting at their table.
I keep my hands clean, and I come to Your altar ready.
So I can shout Your praise and talk about all the wild, awesome things You’ve done.
Lord, I love Your house — the space where Your presence pulls up.
Don’t count me in with the sinners, or lump me in with people who love violence.
Their hands stay full of evil schemes, and their right hands are loaded with bribes.
But me? I’m walking straight. Save me, show me grace, and keep me steady.
My feet are planted on solid ground — and in the whole assembly, I’m praising You loud.
The Lord is my light and the One who keeps me steady; with Him, I’m not scared of anything. The Lord secures my whole life; there’s no one I’m hiding from.
When people came at me as enemies, trying to take me down, they stumbled and fell—just like that.
Even if a whole squad pulls up against me, I’m not shaking; even if a full battle rises around me, my heart stays firm.
There’s just one thing I’m locked in on: to stay in the Lord’s space, to be in His house all my days, to look at His beauty and stay learning in His place.
When things get rough, He hides me in His safe zone; He shields me in His tent; He puts me on a solid spot.
Now my head is lifted above all the enemies around me; and in His tent I’ll offer shouts of joy; I’ll bring offerings and I’ll sing to the Lord.
Lord, hear me when I call; have mercy on me and answer me.
When You said, “Seek My face,” my heart replied, “I’m seeking Your face right now.”
Don’t turn away from me; don’t reject me in anger. You’ve been my help— don’t leave me or let go of me, O God who saves me.
Even if my own parents let go of me, the Lord will take me in.
Lord, teach me Your way and guide me on a straight path because of the ones watching me.
Don’t hand me over to my opponents, because false witnesses rise up and people breathe out violence against me.
I would’ve lost hope if I didn’t believe I’d see the Lord’s goodness in the land of the living.
Wait on the Lord; be strong, and let your heart stay bold. Yes—wait on the Lord.
LORD, I’m calling out to You. You’re the One I lean on. Don’t stay silent, or it’ll feel like I’m just dropping into the void.
Hear me when I lift my voice toward Your holy place, hands up, fully focused on You.
Don’t pull me in with those who do wrong— the ones who talk smooth but carry trouble in their hearts.
Give them what their actions deserve; match their energy according to what they actually do.
They ignore Your works and what Your hands do, so You’ll break them down, and they won’t rise again.
Blessed be the LORD, because He heard my voice when I called out for help.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts Him, and He comes through. My heart lifts, and I give Him praise.
The LORD is strength for His people, and He’s the steady One saving His anointed.
Save Your people, bless Your inheritance, carry them, lift them, and keep them forever.
Give the LORD the honor He’s due — all you heavenly ones, bring Him the full respect and glory.
Give the LORD the glory He deserves; come through with real reverence as you worship His holy greatness.
The LORD’s voice is sounding over the waters; the God of glory is speaking — His voice moves across the wide waters with power.
The LORD’s voice hits with strength; the LORD’s voice shows pure, unmatched majesty.
The LORD’s voice snaps mighty trees; the LORD’s voice breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes Lebanon jump like a young wild ox, and Sirion move like a young mountain creature.
The LORD’s voice flashes out like blazing fire.
The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
The LORD’s voice sends the deer into labor and clears whole forests; and in His temple, everyone speaks of His glory.
The LORD sits as King over the flood; the LORD stays King forever.
The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with real peace.
Lord, You lifted me from trouble and didn’t let me fall; I will praise You forever.
I cried to You for help, and You answered me; You saved me from my enemies.
Lord, You brought me back from the brink and kept me from going down into the grave.
Sing praises to the Lord, all His followers; celebrate His name together.
His anger lasts a moment, but His favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
I trusted You, Lord, and You protected me; You turned my fear into security.
I called to You, and You heard me; You comforted me in my distress.
I will give thanks to You forever, Lord; I will honor You continually.
Lord, do not withhold Your mercy from me; be kind to me and save me.
You changed my suffering into blessings; You lifted me up when I was low.
You removed my sorrow and clothed me with joy; my soul will always rejoice.
I will praise You forever and never stop; my life is committed to Your glory.
Lord, I put my trust in You; let me never be ashamed.
Deliver me in Your righteousness; turn Your ear toward me and save me.
Be my rock and fortress to protect me; guide and rescue me for Your name’s sake.
Pull me out of the trap they set secretly for me, for You are my refuge.
Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, Lord God of truth.
I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but I trust the Lord.
I will be glad and rejoice in Your mercy, for You saw my affliction and knew my soul’s troubles.
You did not give me into the hand of the enemy; You set my feet in a wide place.
Be merciful to me, Lord, for I am in distress; my eye wastes away with grief, my soul and my body.
For my life wastes away with sorrow, and my years with sighing; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones waste away.
Because of all my enemies, I am the talk of the town; they plot to take my life.
But I trust in You, Lord; I say, “You are my God.”
My times are in Your hand; deliver me from the hands of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
Let Your face shine on Your servant; save me in Your mercy.
Lord, do not let me be ashamed, for I call upon You; let the wicked be ashamed.
Let the lying lips be silenced, which speak against the righteous arrogantly and contemptuously.
Oh, how great is Your mercy, which You have laid up for those who fear You; You have shown Your favor to those who trust in You.
Keep me safe, Lord, for I am in trouble; my eye wastes away with grief.
Love the Lord, all His saints; the Lord preserves the faithful and fully rewards the proud doer.
Be strong and take heart, all who hope in the Lord.
Blessed be the Lord, for He has shown me His marvelous kindness in a strong city.
For I said in my haste, “I am cut off from Your sight,” yet You heard my plea.
Love the Lord, all you His saints! The Lord preserves the faithful, but fully repays the proud doer.
Be of good courage, and He will strengthen your heart, all who hope in the Lord.
Blessed is the one whose sin is forgiven and whose wrongdoing is covered.
Blessed is the man the Lord does not charge with sin and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
When I kept silent, my bones wasted away from my groaning all day long.
For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in a drought summer.
I acknowledged my sin to You and did not cover my iniquity; I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the Lord,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin.
Therefore, let everyone who is faithful pray to You while You may be found; let them not repeat the errors of stubborn hearts.
You are my hiding place; You will protect me from trouble; You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
I will instruct and teach you in the way you should go; I will guide you with My eye upon you.
Be not like the horse or mule, which have no understanding, whose mouths must be bridled, else they do not come near you.
Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but mercy surrounds those who trust the Lord.
Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you upright in heart!
Rejoice in the Lord, you righteous! Praise is proper for the upright.
Give thanks to the Lord with the harp; make melody to Him on the ten-stringed lyre.
Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully and shout for joy.
For the word of the Lord is right, and all His works are done in truth.
He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.
By the word of the Lord were the heavens made, and all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.
He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap; He lays up the deep in storehouses.
Let all the earth fear the Lord; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
For He spoke, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.
The Lord brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; He frustrates the devices of the people.
The counsel of the Lord stands forever, the plans of His heart to all generations.
Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people He chose for His inheritance.
The Lord looks from heaven; He sees all the children of men.
From the place of His dwelling He looks upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
He fashions their hearts alike; He considers all their works.
No king is saved by the multitude of an army; a mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
The war horse is a vain hope for safety; neither shall it deliver any by its great strength.
Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon those who fear Him, upon those who hope in His mercy.
To deliver their soul from death and to keep them alive in famine.
Our soul waits for the Lord; He is our help and shield.
For our heart shall rejoice in Him, because we trust in His holy name.
Let Your mercy, Lord, be upon us, even as we hope in You.
I will bless the Lord at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
My soul shall make its boast in the Lord; the humble shall hear and be glad.
O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt His name together.
I sought the Lord, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
They looked to Him and were radiant, and their faces shall never be ashamed.
This poor soul cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear Him, and delivers them.
O taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man who trusts in Him.
O fear the Lord, you His saints; there is no want to those who fear Him.
The young lions lack and suffer hunger, but they who seek the Lord shall not lack any good thing.
Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
What man is he that desires life and loves many days, that he may see good?
Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking guile.
Depart from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears are open to their cry.
The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.
The righteous cry, and the Lord hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
The Lord is near to those who are brokenhearted, and saves such as are crushed in spirit.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord delivers him out of them all.
He keeps all his bones; not one of them is broken.
Evil shall slay the wicked, and those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
The Lord redeems the soul of His servants, and none of those who trust in Him shall be condemned.
Contend, Lord, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.
Take hold of shield and buckler, and rise up for my help.
Draw out the spear, and stop those who pursue me; say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”
Let those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; let them be turned back and put to shame.
Let them be like chaff before the wind; let the angel of the Lord chase them.
Let their way be dark and slippery; let the angel of the Lord pursue them.
For without cause they hid their net to catch me; without cause they dug a pit for my soul.
Let ruin come upon them suddenly; let them be taken in the net they hid; let them fall into their own mischief.
And my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; it shall delight in His salvation.
All my bones shall say, “Lord, who is like You? You deliver the poor from the strong, the needy from the oppressor.”
False witnesses rise up; they ask of me things I do not know.
They reward me evil for good; my soul is bowed down.
Yet, as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I humbled my soul with fasting.
I prayed with my head bowed on my chest, as though mourning a friend or brother.
But in my adversity, they rejoiced and gathered; they gathered against me without cause; they mocked me, they gnashed with their teeth.
Lord, how long will You look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
I will give You thanks in the great congregation; I will praise You among much people.
Let not those who are my enemies triumph over me; let not those who hate me without cause wink with the eye.
For they speak not peace, but they devise deceit against the quiet in the land.
They opened their mouth wide against me; they said, “Ah, ah, our eyes have seen it.”
This You have seen, Lord; keep not silence; Lord, be not far from me.
Stir up Yourself, and awake to my judgment, to my cause, my God and Lord.
Judge me, Lord my God, according to Your righteousness; let them not triumph over me.
Let them not say in their hearts, “Ah, so we would have it.” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up.”
Let them be ashamed and disappointed together who rejoice at my hurt; let them be clothed with shame and dishonor.
Let them shout for joy and be glad who favor my righteous cause, and say continually, “Let the Lord be magnified, who loves the peace of His servant.”
And my tongue shall speak of Your righteousness and Your praise all the day long.
Lord, I will rejoice in You; I will praise Your name forever, for it is good.
Fret not yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious against the workers of iniquity.
For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
Trust in the Lord, and do good; dwell in the land, and feed on His faithfulness.
Delight yourself also in the Lord, and He shall give you the desires of your heart.
Commit your way unto the Lord; trust also in Him, and He shall bring it to pass.
And He shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, and your judgment as the noonday.
Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for Him; fret not yourself because of him who prospers in his way.
Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; fret not yourself in any wise to do evil.
For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait on the Lord, they shall inherit the land.
For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be; yea, you shall diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes upon him with his teeth.
The Lord shall laugh at him; for He sees that his day is coming.
The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to slay such as are of upright conversation.
Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
A little that a righteous man has is better than the riches of many wicked.
For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; but the Lord upholds the righteous.
The Lord knows the days of the upright; and their inheritance shall be forever.
They shall not be ashamed in the evil time; and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs; they shall consume, vanish; into smoke shall they consume away.
The wicked borrows, and pays not again; but the righteous shows mercy, and gives.
For such as are blessed of Him shall inherit the earth; and they that are cursed of Him shall be cut off.
The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord; and He delights in his way.
Though he falls, he shall not be utterly cast down; for the Lord upholds him with His hand.
I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
He is ever merciful, and lends; and his seed is blessed.
Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell forevermore.
For the Lord loves judgment, and forsakes not His saints; they are preserved forever.
The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein forever.
The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue talks of judgment.
The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to slay him.
The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
Wait on the Lord, and keep His way, and He shall exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not; yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright; for the end of that man is peace.
But the transgressors shall be destroyed together; the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord; He is their strength in the time of trouble.
And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them; He shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in Him.
Lord, rebuke me not in Your anger, neither chasten me in Your hot displeasure.
For Your arrows stick fast in me, and Your hand presses down upon me.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of Your indignation; there is no health in my bones because of my sin.
For my iniquities are gone over my head; like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
I am troubled, I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
For my loins are filled with burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
I am feeble and sore broken; I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
Lord, all my desire is before You; and my sighing is not hid from You.
My heart pants; my strength fails me; as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.
My lovers and friends stand aloof from my plague, and my kinsmen stand afar off.
They also that seek after my life lay snares for me; they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
But I, like a deaf man, hear not; and I am as a dumb man that opens not his mouth.
Thus I am as a man that hears not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
For in You, O Lord, do I hope; You will hear, Lord my God.
For I said, “Let them not rejoice over me, who are my enemies without cause; and let not those who hate me without reason wink with the eye.”
For I am ready to fall, and my sorrow is continually before me.
For I will declare my iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
But my enemies are vigorous, and they are mighty; and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
They also that render evil for good are my adversaries; because I follow that which is good.
Forsake me not, O Lord; O my God, be not far from me.
Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
I said, “I will watch my ways, lest I sin with my tongue; I will keep my mouth with a muzzle while the wicked is before me.”
I was dumb with silence; I held my peace even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
My heart was hot within me; while I was musing, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:
“Lord, make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.”
Behold, You have made my days as a handbreadth; and my age is as nothing before You; verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
Surely every man walks in a vain show; surely they are disquieted in vain; he heaps up riches, and knows not who shall gather them.
And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in You.
Deliver me from all my transgressions; make me not the reproach of the foolish.
I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because You did it.
Remove Your stroke away from me; I am consumed by the blow of Your hand.
When You with rebukes correct man for iniquity, You make his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear to my cry; hold not Your peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with You, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
I waited patiently for the Lord; and He inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.
Blessed is that man who makes the Lord his trust, and respects not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

Many, O Lord my God, are Your wonderful works which You have done, and Your thoughts toward us; they cannot be reckoned up in order unto You: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
Sacrifice and offering You did not desire; mine ears have You opened: burnt offering and sin offering have You not required.
Then said I, “Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me, to do Your will, O my God: I delight to do Your will, O my God; yea, Your law is within my heart.”
I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Lord, You know.
I have not hid Your righteousness within my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and Your salvation: I have not concealed Your lovingkindness and Your truth from the great congregation.
Withhold not You Your tender mercies from me, O Lord: let Your lovingkindness and Your truth continually preserve me.
For innumerable evils have compassed me about: my iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head: therefore my heart fails me.
Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.
Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that desire my hurt.
Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, “Aha, aha.”
Let all those that seek You rejoice and be glad in You: let such as love Your salvation say continually, “The Lord be magnified.”
But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinks upon me: You are my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
Blessed is he who considers the poor; the Lord will deliver him in the time of trouble.
The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; he shall be blessed upon the earth, and shall not deliver him up to the will of his enemies.
The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: You will make all his bed in his sickness.
I said, “Lord, be merciful unto me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against You.”
My enemies speak evil of me, “When shall he die, and his name perish?”
And if he comes to see me, he speaks vanity; his heart gathers iniquity to itself; when he goes abroad, he tells it.
All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
An evil disease, say they, cleaves fast unto him: and now that he lies he shall rise up no more.
Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who did eat of my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
But You, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
By this I know that You favor me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.
And as for me, You uphold me in mine integrity, and set me before Your face forever.
Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
Like a deer that’s thirsty for water, my soul is thirsty for You, God.
My soul thirsts for God, the living God; when will I stand in His presence?
My tears have been my food day and night, while they keep asking me, “Where’s your God?”
When I remember, I pour out my soul; I went with the crowd to God’s house, keeping the festival.
Why am I so down, my soul? Hope in God; I’ll still praise Him, my Savior and my God.
My soul is downcast within me; that’s why I remember You from the land of Jordan and Mount Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
Deep waters call to deep at the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your waves and breakers roll over me.
The Lord commands His lovingkindness in the day, and at night His song is with me, my prayer to God of my life.
I say to God my rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why am I mourning because of the enemy?”
My bones suffer because my foes mock me; all day they ask, “Where’s your God?”
Why am I down, my soul? Hope in God; I’ll still praise Him, my Savior and my God.
Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against a wicked nation; save me from deceitful and evil people.
For You are my God; why have You rejected me? Why am I mourning because of the enemy?
Send out Your light and Your truth; let them guide me and bring me to Your holy hill, to Your dwelling place.
Then I will go to God’s altar, to God my great joy; I will praise You with the harp, O God my God.
Why am I down, my soul? Hope in God; I will still praise Him, my Savior and my God.
We have heard, O God, our fathers told us what You did in their days, long ago.
You drove out nations before them and gave them the land, not by their sword but by Your hand and Your arm.
For they did not get the land by their own strength, nor did their own arm save them; but Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
You are my King, O God; command victories for Jacob.
Through You we push down our enemies; through Your name we trample those that rise up against us.
I do not trust in my bow; my sword does not save me.
But You have saved us from our enemies, and put those who hate us to shame.
We glory in God all the day, and praise Your name forever. Selah.
But You have rejected us, and put us to shame, and do not go with our armies.
You make us turn back from the enemy; those who hate us take spoil.
You have given us as sheep to be eaten; and have scattered us among the nations.
You sell Your people for nothing, and do not increase Your wealth by their price.
You make us a reproach to our neighbors, the scorn and derision of those around us.
You make us a byword among the nations, the laughingstock of the peoples.
My shame is daily before me, and confusion covers my face.
For the voice of the taunter and reviler, because of the enemy and the avenger.
All this has come upon us; yet we have not forgotten You, neither have we dealt falsely in Your covenant.
Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps declined from Your way.
Yet You have crushed us in the place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
If we had forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god,
Would not God search it out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.
Yea, for Your sake we are killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
Awake, why do You sleep, O Lord? arise, do not reject us forever.
Why do You hide Your face and forget our oppression and suffering?
For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly clings to the earth.
Arise to help us, and redeem us for Your mercy’s sake.
